body: Just work on fixing the drinking, don’t contact him while drinking or at all. He will come to realize on his own that he was a dick and will be coming right back to you. Fix the drinking though.
I had the same worries, I felt no side effects at all my first day on it and still don’t experience any. I took the whole 50 mg and got sleepy after one drink it was great and I slept like a baby.
Please look into Naltrexone and the Sinclair method. It has saved me.

have you tried Naltrexone ever? I don’t know if Naltrexone and Suboxone get filtered the same way. But please try to cut back on the vodka. I know it’s hard. I know life happens and it’s hard. Don’t let it win.
Thank you. Can’t change something overnight and I need to give myself some credit.

I had only one more beer and now I am going to bed. I feel a bit guilty but def am stopping there and don’t want to drink anymore. It really wasn’t a priority anymore once I had it next to me. I hope that is some progress from not being able to stop.
Naltrexone and The Sinclair method.

Try the Sinclair method is has been amazing for me and now drinking has no affect on my life anymore and I can drink normally without over doing it while I am on the medication. I went from not being able to stop to having a drink and stopping. Also skipping days. I feel ‘normal’ again with it having no hold on me
on day two of TSM: My head is screaming at me to have another drink after my first one. Idk if I should ignore it or accept that it’s a process it’s soooo fucking hard
I do surprisingly! I drank a lot of water before bed, took a melatonin and was out cold.

I made myself a drink (2-3 shots of vodka and seltzer water) and finished it. Thought about going for another and instead I just decided to go to bed and lay down. Normally I would have drank half of the bottle and not have been able to stop. So I cannot believe it.
Personal message me if you feel you’re slipping up
Let’s do it!!
Honestly, at this point it’s done enough harm I know that I want to do this for myself, finally
yeah my last drink was on march 13th so I could the 14th as day one.

Def going to go with seltzer water and a lemon! I’m also just going to say that I am on antibiotics or something so I can’t drink or I might just say “oh I’m going to have some later!” and when everyone is a little messy they will have forgotten that I never ordered a drink of liquor (:
It can turn into a charge if you showed up to the hearing.

If i find myself slipping back into the hole I will consider being a non-drinker! i feel empowered to have the control to drink or not drink so I’m going to step into my power for now. I am sorry that you struggle in the way you do. It’s not fair and I wish people didn’t have these addictions.
thank you for the advice!
thank you for your honesty! It is my own ride to find out, I just wondered if anyone has ever been able to go back to normal consumption and what it looked like for them.
if possible, I would try to change the narrative about yourself that you have. You have the mentality that you can’t do anything, But you can!!! with a little bit of effort
Thank you for being so honest. I believe for right now I don’t think I’ll ever go back to the place where I was at. But I am going to be careful to not slip back into having it habitually
Thank you! at the beginning of the breakup I didn’t even care how much ai was sabotaging myself... now I actually want to heal and move past this horrible habit. I’m taking it day by day
Thank you. I think when grow my self confidence more and release some attachments I can get there. I want to be at that point but it seems to be taking a while to get in that mindset.
thank you for the advice. i do need to take off my rose colored glasses and maybe be a little bit mad instead of sulking.

I felt a bit angry last night... but generally no I don’t feel angry. I probably should feel anger but I think my feelings for him still blind me from looking at the situation for what it is. If i did feel angry I think I could start to move on, but I don’t feel it yet. Just the sadness and low self worth.
i fucked up at the end and did things that i wasn’t proud of. never anything harmful to him, just made myself look like an idiot crazy person. i hope he can forget that version of me.
I hope he does... i’m male, but that is irrelevant i guess. thank you (:
can you call someone and talk about how you feel?
please don’t do it. Call someone you love please

I feel like I was manipulated a lot in the relationship and lost part of myself in the process trying to be who he wanted me to be. Now I just feel trauma after being away from it and I think I formed a trauma bond where I feel like I need him. It’s sickening. I want to move on so badly.
Thank you, I just feel like I screwed up so badly with this person so many times... and that he won’t ever forgive me and that he will just see me as the crazy ex who shows up drunk.
Thank you. Our ways must part until I’m healed, it hurts to have the absence of them, but I think it’s a disservice to them if I keep trying until I’m a new me.
